reviews.title: Troublesome eSIM for the US
reviews.body:
Purchased an eSIM for the US. 
On installing the Lebara app and connecting my account the eSIM showed as being a different amount, time and data bundle than the one I paid for. Fixed by helpful chat support my but required installing eSIM again by a different route than the initial email suggested.

While in the US, the eSIM started showing ‘No internet connection’ while in good coverage, and while only halfway through the time and data package. Again, took a session with helpful chat support to ‘fix’ it - basically requiring me to toggle airplane mode on and off ‘a few times’ every time it broke - which was several times a day. 

The US eSIM package I bought also has no number. Not that unusual but worth being aware of. 

I’ve used eSIMs several times and Lebara was by far the most troublesome
